There are better and worse markets,
absolutely, for any type of service. But guess how you can pay down that risk.
Instead of being like, "Oh, I think I want to open up a location in, you know,
La Habra." What I would do is I would run ads. So, I'd spend like $500 or
$1,000 in five or 10 markets. And I would see where I got the lowest lead
cost. Well, what do you do when people opt in and then you don't have a
location? Do what 99% of business owners do anyways. Ignore the leads. You'll be
okay. They'll just keep living their lives. But you get to avoid signing a
five-year lease for a bad spot.
